description: This file defines the DefaultNotesRepository class, implementing the NotesRepository interface for managing notes. It handles CRUD operations, synchronization logic with remote API, local database interactions, and sync status updates within a note-taking app.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepository
classes.description: Implementation of the NotesRepository interface; manages note CRUD operations, synchronization with remote API, local database updates, and sync status tracking.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a StateFlow to observe the current sync status.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a Flow of notes filtered by a search query, with proper escaping for safe LIKE searches.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits updates to a specific note identified by its id.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the provided title and content, generating a unique ID and setting timestamps.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note’s title and content while preserving its creation timestamp and marking it as dirty.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted via tombstone deletion for sync propagation.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Manually initiates a sync process and updates sync status accordingly.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Performs the synchronization process: uploads dirty notes, downloads remote changes, merges updates, and updates sync markers, including local cleanup.
